title: Joseph's Dream
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: Joseph was a carpenter who made things from wood. He was going to marry Mary. Then he learned she was going to have a baby, and he was worried.
Joseph was a good, kind man. He did not want to hurt Mary. He thought about quietly ending the wedding plans.
Then an angel came to him in a dream. “Joseph, do not be afraid to marry Mary. Her baby is from the Holy Ghost.”
p2: “Name Him Jesus, for He will save His people from their sins.” When Joseph woke up, he did just what the angel said.
When you feel worried, tell Heavenly Father. He can help you know what to do, just like He helped Joseph.
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
